description: This PHP file contains a unit test class for the FormatWithCompetency class within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. It sets up test data, initializes the class, and verifies that it correctly formats competency values.

classes.name: FormatWithCompetencyTest
classes.description: A test class extending KernelTestCase to verify the correctness of the getFormattedValue() method in FormatWithCompetency.

methods.name: setUp

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
